ground_truth: To skip the regex for converter-less routes, `RoutePattern.match()` now compares the path with `self._route` using string operations (`==`, `startswith`, `removeprefix`). `_route` can be a lazy translation object (`gettext_lazy()` routes, e.g. with i18n URL patterns). Lazy proxies don't behave like `str` for `str.startswith()` / `str.removeprefix()`, so such routes fail to match or raise. Fixed by coercing the route with `str(self._route)` at match time.
